prompt_text: I'll find him for three... but I'll catch him, and kill him, for ten. You gotta make up your minds. Gonna stay alive and ante up? Or gonna play it cheap, be on welfare the whole winter? I don't want no volunteers; I don't want no mates. There’s too many captains on this island. Ten thousand dollars for me, by myself. For that, you get the head, the tail, the whole damn thing.
